scientific_question: Does conditioning on one requested key onset or release being present in a 16-frame window materially improve exact engine-truth offset localization over an otherwise matched independent dense-BCE event head?

authorization.scope: Phase-1 oracle-window design, implementation, execution, and decision; Phase 2 only after the frozen gate

repository_receipt.policy: Exact relevant working-byte hashes below are authoritative because the user prohibited a new commit. Unrelated concurrent working-tree changes and later unrelated HEAD motion cannot alter the study bytes silently.

dataset.construction_policy: For every valid active contiguous transition t, require the union t-23..t+23 to remain inside one continuity run and be entirely input-active; require exactly one event of the requested key/polarity throughout t-15..t+15; only then assign one deterministic pseudorandom offset balanced within split/session/head to max-minus-min <= 1. The crop is [t-offset-8, t-offset+23].

expected_support.reason: known engine-counter fragmentation leaves no all-offset-safe 32-frame crop

model.head_order: seven onset heads in data.schema.KEY_ORDER, then seven release heads
model.feature_delta_reason: The matched aligned-TCN control uses its native-rate width-five stem; explicit projected deltas would change the declared support.

matched_dense_bce.objective: independent BCE over the 16 requested-head logits
matched_dense_bce.target: one positive requested event and fifteen negative offsets

conditional_softmax.objective: 16-way exact-offset cross-entropy conditional on the requested event being present

training.sampling: each event exactly once per epoch in a deterministic shared permutation
training.task_balance: inverse task-count loss weights normalized to mean one; no oversampling

current_dense_reference.weights: final; byte-identical to selected at step 14265
current_dense_reference.role: unmatched historical current-model reference, reported on exact common support and excluded from the gate

evaluation.bootstrap_policy: paired resampling of whole session/run/block identities; no block crosses a continuity boundary
evaluation.primary_statistic: equal-estimable-head macro exact accuracy, conditional_softmax minus matched_dense_bce
evaluation.multiplicity: one primary comparison; per-head intervals are descriptive

seed_zero.rule: Every condition must pass before confirmation seeds are run.

phase_two.rule: Apply the unchanged seed-zero gate to the arithmetic mean of the three seed metrics, require positive exact delta in at least two of three seeds, and require the paired block-bootstrap lower bound to remain above zero.

failure_policy.pooled_feature_no_signal: If conditional exact localization is not clearly above chance, do not infer intrinsic visual ambiguity. Run one separately frozen learned native-rate pixel/frame-pair differential adapter before that conclusion.
failure_policy.seed_zero_gate_failure: Do not run confirmation seeds and do not implement Phase 2. Report the failed clauses and all negative results.
failure_policy.partial_artifact: Preserve the failed output under its unique path; never reuse it as completion.
